content.text: Section 11 fully satisfies the rule. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: 11.1 Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form. Assistance includes knowledge transfer, export support, cooperation with a replacement supplier, orderly migration, and continued service at the then-current scope and service levels.
input.rationale: Section 11 already meets or exceeds our preferred position on all three elements: (a) 11.1 gives up to six months' transition assistance on expiry or termination for any reason, at the rates in the expiring Order Form (better for us than then-current rates) and including knowledge transfer, migration and cooperation with a replacement supplier; (b) 11.2 requires return of all Customer Data within thirty days in a complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format with metadata, and bars withholding for fee disputes; (c) 11.3 requires secure deletion after we confirm successful return, with written officer certification and continued protection of any legally required retained copy. Cross-references are consistent: 10.1 preserves access through the agreed transition period and our Customer Data rights, 10.2 covers Deliverables and refunds, and 16.5 expressly defers Customer Data to Sections 11 and 15 so its return-or-destroy duty cannot trigger premature deletion. No redline needed.
